description: Offers to git init/commit the current project and, optionally, create a GitHub repo (via `gh`) and push — always behind two explicit confirmations, one for the local commit and one for the remote create+push. Use right after a project was just generated by `/init-project`, right after `java-spring-boot-developer` reports a feature implemented successfully by `/new-feature-implement`, when `/new-feature` ends with an approved spec, or whenever the user asks to create a git repo, commit, or push the current project.
